# Probability and Statistics

Expected value: E[X] = ∑ₓ x · P(X = x)

Variance: Var(X) = E[X²] − (E[X])²

Standard deviation: σ = √(Var(X))

Covariance: Cov(X, Y) = E[XY] − E[X]E[Y]

Correlation: ρ = Cov(X, Y) / (σₓ · σᵧ)

Binomial: P(X = k) = (n choose k) · pᵏ · (1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ

Normal PDF: φ(x) = (1/√(2π)) · e⁻ˣ²⁄²

Law of large numbers: X̄ₙ → μ as n → ∞

Central limit theorem: √n(X̄ₙ − μ) / σ → N(0,1)

Bayes: P(Aᵢ|B) = P(B|Aᵢ)P(Aᵢ) / ∑ⱼ P(B|Aⱼ)P(Aⱼ)
